findings.finding: Draft GH-FR-025 and companion CI-performance candidates specify p95 budgets (60 seconds targeted/critical; 3 minutes full), duration/runner measurement, and Performance Recovery on overrun. The current L2/L11 handoff/disposition for those draft conditions is unclear; the source status does not establish an adopted requirement or a regression.
findings.status: draft-source handoff/disposition unclear; recommend carrying the exact candidate scope, values, measurement fields, and recovery condition to HELIX-owned CI OS/L3 disposition; do not infer adoption, retirement, or universal product thresholds
